properties.name: spring.profiles.active
properties.description: Active Spring profile. Set via env SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE.

properties.name: sbp.gateway.port
properties.description: HTTP port for the API gateway. Overridden by env GATEWAY_PORT.

properties.name: sbp.api.public-base-path
properties.description: Public API base path segment for the gateway.

properties.name: management.endpoint.health.show-details
properties.description: Health endpoint detail visibility: never, when-authorized, or always.

properties.name: sbp.services.auth.url
properties.description: Base URL of the auth service. Overridden by env AUTH_SERVICE_URL.

properties.name: sbp.services.user.url
properties.description: Base URL of the user service. Overridden by env USER_SERVICE_URL.

properties.name: sbp.internal-api.base-path
properties.description: Reserved base path for internal gateway APIs.

properties.name: spring.devtools.restart.enabled
properties.description: Enable DevTools restart on classpath changes (dev profile).
